scope: Prospective old/new River action-subtree parallelism comparison, F32 compact hands only. No build, pilot, I16, external reference or R1 certification.
prospective_amendment: The source04 baseline completed and was recovered before Spot termination at 2026-09-26T03:31:56Z. No action measurements had started; unused source05 is superseded by source06. Allow prior-boot baseline provenance only. The 1000-iteration count, 48-stage order, guards and limits remain fixed before action measurement.
order: Blocks 0 through 3, ascending thread count within each block. Each old/new pair is old-first when (block + thread-index) is even, otherwise new-first. Block zero is warmup. All 48 processes are retained; only blocks 1..3 enter timing summaries. Three measured pairs cannot perfectly balance pair order at each thread count; across six thread counts each order occurs nine times.
correctness: All 48 processes must have exactly equal original canonical.bin and state.bin bytes, quality including EV/BR/NashConv f64 bits, global hand IDs and tree metadata. F32 only; complete compact state is compared, not I16 or inactive dense hands.

guard.interpretation: Prospective descriptive adoption guards, not confidence intervals. Report three paired win counts and all six thread medians, speedups, efficiencies and adjacent slowdowns; never loosen thresholds or select samples after seeing results.

measurement: Old/new builds and all 48 action measurements must share one new 32-logical-CPU boot. The recovered completed 32-CPU baseline may be from a previous boot; preserve its original binary, exact source04 manifest/archive, input and frozen 1000 River iterations. Rebuilding that exact old source on the new boot may produce a different binary hash. No new pilot, count selection or cross-boot timing comparison. On the measurement host, unrestricted or >=32 CPU quota, <=12 GiB outer cgroup and zero swap. Old/new source archives, manifests, build results/records, binaries, original baseline plan/frozen counts, config, local runner/helper/protocol and raw outputs are pinned. No concurrent build, transfer or other experiment during measurement. Timed solver run excludes setup/query/artifact phases. Native peak RSS and sampled summed RSS remain distinct; empty phase sample intervals report null.
failure: No retry. Any failure, identity/solution mismatch or insufficient remaining time stops execution and marks the exact remaining schedule skipped. Incomplete evidence has no adoption guard result. Preparation and measurement are separate phases; builds are external. Original range-scaling protocol is unchanged.
